newsitem.title: USA: Coventry finalizes $42 mln Warburg deal.
newsitem.headline: Coventry finalizes $42 mln Warburg deal.

text.p: Coventry Corp said Monday it finalized a deal whereby Warburg Pincus Ventures LP bought $40 million of its convertible exchangeable subordinated notes and $2.35 million in warrants.
Coventry said Warburg bought the remaining $14 million of the notes and warrants, having closed another $28 million in May. The company announced the deal March 17.
Chief financial officer Dale Wolf said Coventry also sold Warburg warrants to buy 2.35 million shares. The warrants, which Coventry sold for $1 each, have an exercise price of 10-5/8, Wolf said.
The managed health care company's stock traded at 14-7/8 Monday afternoon, down 1/8.
Wolf said the company used the proceeds to reduce bank debt by about $34 million and will keep the balance for general corporate purposes.
